resources.string: Sign in to monitor your device
Location tracking is active — tap to open
Notification permission is required to show tracking status in the notification bar.
Location permission is required to track your device position.
Background location is required for continuous tracking when the app is not open.
Call history is not available. Google Play and Android restrict call log access for most apps. This feature is intentionally disabled.
WhatsApp message reading is not supported. Private message databases cannot be accessed per Android security policy.
